task: Write an executable plan for migrating Proof-or-stop agent documentation from a Claude-first root contract to host-neutral thin entrypoints and canonical verified documentation sources.
outcome: The repository contains docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-thin-entrypoint-contract-migration-execution-plan.md, and docs/requirements/NAV.md links to it with the correct decision count; a maintainer can follow its ordered Story slices, red/green tests, compatibility steps, B-e514 convergence path, and rollback rules without guessing which files or contracts to change.
facts: Codex discovers AGENTS.md rather than CODEX.md.
Antigravity/agy consumes AGENTS.md and does not require AGY.md.
Claude Code discovers CLAUDE.md and supports a host-specific compatibility entry.
B-e514 has thin root documents in TEST but DONE-required validation fails because old process-fact verification still requires long-form facts in root entries.
.lattice/Lattice.md is the intended host-neutral entry navigation but is currently too small and contains stale commands/branding.
audit, docs-drift, prompts, templates, and verification scripts contain hard-coded CLAUDE.md assumptions.
constraints: This Story is documentation-only and writes only the new decision document and docs/requirements/NAV.md.
The plan must not invent CODEX.md or AGY.md.
The plan must preserve host discovery while eliminating duplicated lifecycle/process facts.
Operational projections must be mechanically checked against registries and normative decisions.
The plan must not claim that proposed runtime changes are already implemented.
Existing unrelated dirty files and B-e514 state must remain untouched.
